controlling_quotation: Lemon Squeezy is no longer accepting new sign-ups and will shut down on March 31, 2027

candidate.scope: Existing runnable QA example using companion verifier and synthetic CSV fixtures. A self-serve download is distinct from the email service. Paid redistribution rights were not established.

conditions.country: Saved supported-country documentation lists Canada for bank payouts. This does not grant seller onboarding or establish a payout method for GlobalLand.
conditions.product: Saved product rules generally permit digital goods fulfilled on-site and prohibit services of any kind. Specific AI-produced artifact approval remains unverified.
conditions.fees: Saved fee example shows USD 0.50 plus 5% of total order value and an additional international fee in its example. Upfront or recurring charges and actual payout costs for this seller were not established.
conditions.marketplace: The generic help index is insufficient for admission or discoverability.
conditions.account: No eligible existing store was evidenced. New signup is explicitly closed. The documented shutdown also limits any grandfathered route.

commercial_decision: Do not prepare a listing or extrapolate hypothetical proceeds for this closed signup route. Keep the existing free download available through its independent route.
reconsider_if: Official evidence of an intake route currently open to this seller with enough time to sell and receive payouts, plus verified rights and product acceptance for the exact download. A successor platform requires its own evidence.
